name: Naga Disciple
body:
More charming and amenable than other aberrations, nagas can sometimes interbreed with humanoid races or, more frequently, teach their magic to other creatures, sealing a “blood pact” with them. These blessed -or cursed- spellcasters can become naga disciples when they strive to achieve the same form, powers and grace of their patrons.

Requirements

To qualify to become a naga disciple, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Race: Any non-naga.
Skills: Knowledge (dungeoneering) 5 ranks.
Languages: Aklo.
Spellcasting: Able to spontaneously cast 1st-level arcane spells. A sorcerer or bloodrager with this prestige class must have the naga bloodline. If the character gains levels of sorcerer or bloodrager after taking this class, she must take the naga bloodline.
Class Skills

The naga disciple’s class skills are Bluff (Cha), Diplomacy (Cha), Escape Artist (Dex), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (any) (Int), Perception (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), and Stealth (Dex).

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Hit Die: d8.

Class Features

All of the following are class features of the naga disciple prestige class.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Naga disciples gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Spells per Day

At the indicated levels, a naga disciple gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in an arcane spellcasting class she belonged to before adding the prestige class. She does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if she is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If a character had more than one spellcasting class before becoming a naga disciple, she must decide to which class she adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

Naga Progeny

A naga disciple adds her level to her sorcerer or bloodrager levels when determining the powers gained from her bloodline. A character with levels in both bloodrager and sorcerer must choose which class stacks with her naga disciple levels to determine her bloodline powers. If she does not have levels in sorcerer or bloodrager, she instead gains bloodline powers of the naga sorcerer bloodline, using her naga disciple level as her sorcerer level to determine the bonuses gained. This ability does not grant bonus spells to a sorcerer or bloodrager unless she possesses spell slots of an appropriate level. Such bonus spells are automatically granted if the sorcerer or bloodrager gains spell slots of the spell’s level.

Table: Naga Disciple
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special	Spells per Day
1st	+0	+1	+0	+1	Naga progeny, natural armor increase +1, serpentine gift	—
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Ability boost (Dex +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
3rd	+2	+2	+1	+2	Naga form (1/day), serpentine gift	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
4th	+3	+2	+1	+2	Ability boost (Dex +2), natural armor increase +2	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
5th	+3	+3	+2	+3	Bloodline feat, darkvision 30 ft., naga form (2/day)	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
6th	+4	+3	+2	+3	Ability boost (Con +2), serpentine gift	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
7th	+5	+4	+2	+4	Naga form (3/day), natural armor increase +3	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
8th	+6	+4	+3	+4	Ability boost (Cha +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
9th	+6	+5	+3	+5	Serpentine gift	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
10th	+7	+5	+3	+5	Darkvision 60 ft.	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
Natural Armor Increase (Ex)

At 1st, 4th, and 7th level, a naga disciple gains an occult protection from attacks, causing a cumulative increase to her natural armor bonus of +1.

Serpentine Gift

At 1st level, 3rd level, and every 3 levels thereafter, a naga disciple gains a serpentine gift, a special ability that grants her some of the powers of a real naga. Each gift can only be chosen once unless noted otherwise.

Amphibious (Ex)

The naga disciple gains a swim speed equal to her land speed and the amphibious universal monster ability.

Blindsense (Su)

The naga disciple gains blindsense in a 30 ft. radius.

Bonus Feat

The naga disciple gains a bonus bloodline feat. If the disciple belongs to a class that grants bonus feats as a class feature, she can instead gain a bonus feat of that type, stacking her naga disciple levels and her levels in that class for the purpose of meeting the feat’s prerequisites.

Burrow (Ex)

The naga disciple gains a burrow speed of 30 feet.

Cast Without Hands (Su)

The naga disciple gains the cast without hands ability of the sorcerer naga bloodline, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. Once her level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, using it doesn’t increase the spell failure chance from her armor. A naga disciple must be at least 9th level to select this gift.

Charming Gaze (Su)

The naga disciple gains a gaze attack that has the effect of charm person on a target within 30 feet. The save DC for this attack is 10 + 1/2 the naga disciple’s sorcerer/bloodrager level + her naga disciple level + her Charisma modifier.

Climb (Ex)

The naga disciple gains a climb speed of 30 feet.

Compression (Ex)

The naga disciple gains the compression universal monster ability.

Detect Thoughts (Sp)

The naga disciple can detect thoughts at will, as the spell. She must be at least 3rd level to select this gift.

Dreamsight (Ex)

With a brief glance, the naga disciple can see a hazy image of the current dreams of sleeping creatures.

Ensnaring Eyes (Su)

The naga disciple gains the ensnaring eyes ability of the naga sorcerer bloodline, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. Once her level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the naga disciple’s bonus on save DCs of charm or fascinating effects she uses increases to +4. A naga disciple must be at least 6th level to select this gift.

Extra Naga Form (Sp)

The naga disciple can use her naga form ability once more per day. She must be at least 9th level to select this gift.

Fly (Ex)

The naga disciple gains a fly speed of 30 feet with good maneuverability.

Guarded Thoughts (Ex)

The naga disciple is immune to any form of mind reading, such as that granted by detect thoughts. She also gains a +2 racial bonus on all saves against charm effects. A naga disciple must be at least 6th level and have the detect thoughts ability to select this gift.

Low-Light Vision (Ex)

The naga disciple gains low-light vision. If she already possessed it, she instead gains darkvision 30 ft. or adds 30 ft. to her darkvision range.

Poison Fangs (Su)

The naga disciple gains the poison fangs ability of the naga bloodrager bloodline, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. If she already possesses poison fangs through her bloodline, her effective bloodrager level doubles for the purpose of calculating her poison’s save DC. A naga disciple must be at least 6th level and have the serpent fangs ability to select this gift.

Poison Immunity (Su)

The naga disciple becomes immune to poison. She must be at least 9th level and have the serpent fangs and poison fangs abilities to select this gift.

Psychic Sensitivity (Ex)

The naga disciple gains Psychic Sensitivity as a bonus feat.

Scent (Ex)

The naga disciple gains the scent universal monster ability.

Serpent Fangs (Su)

The naga disciple gains the serpent fangs ability of the naga bloodrager bloodline, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. If she already possesses serpent fangs through her bloodline, the damage dealt increases to 1d10 (1d8 if the naga disciple is Small). When her effective bloodrager level increases to 8th, the naga disciple deals 1d12 damage with her serpent fangs (1d10 if she is Small). A naga disciple must have the bloodrage class ability to select this gift.

Spell Resistance (Su)

The naga disciple gains spell resistance equal to her sorcerer/bloodrager level + her naga disciple level + 11.

Tremorsense (Ex)

The naga disciple gains tremorsense in a 60-ft. radius.

Vanishing (Sp)

The naga disciple gains the vanishing ability of the naga sorcerer bloodline, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. If she already possesses vanishing through her bloodline, the naga disciple’s invisibility can extend to other creatures too, as per the greater invisibility spell’s description.

Ability Boost

As her body slowly covers in snakelike scales, a naga disciple gains stat boosts as noted on Table 15: Naga Disciple. These increases stack and are gained as if through level advancement.

Bloodline Feat

Upon reaching 2nd level, and every three levels thereafter, a naga disciple receives one bonus feat, chosen from the sorcerer naga bloodline’s bonus feat list or from the bloodrager naga bloodline’s bonus feat list, depending on which one she is advancing with her level progression.

Naga Form (Sp)

At 3rd level, a naga disciple’s magic blood grants her the ability to assume the shape of a true naga once per day. This ability works like naga shape I. At 5th level, this ability functions as naga shape II and can be used twice per day; at 7th level, it functions as naga shape III and the naga disciple can use this ability three times per day. Her caster level for this effect is equal to her effective sorcerer or bloodrager levels for her naga bloodline.

Darkvision (Ex)

At 5th level, the naga disciple gains darkvision with a range of 30 feet. If she already possessed darkvision, the ability range increases by 30 feet instead. At 10th level, the naga disciple adds another 30 feet to her darkvision range.
